definition: Your Honor is the traditional way to address a judge. It is used as a sign of respect. The honorific typically appears in court proceedings. The term is sometimes controversial, as some see it as a title of “nobility” that places them above the general public. See the use of the Your Honor by Mr. Matthews and Ms. Hupp in Uttecht v. Brown, 551 U.S. 1 (2007). yield / Your Honor Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
